If you’re looking for a yacht that elegantly combines high-end luxury with innovative design and exceptional performance, the 80 ft OKEAN is here to redefine your expectations. For the first time, this breathtaking vessel has arrived in the United States, making its debut in the vibrant waters of Miami, Florida. With a length of 79’5” and a beam of 19’1”, the 80′ OKEAN offers an unparalleled experience for yacht enthusiasts.

Designed to Impress

The 80′ Okean features a groundbreaking open layout that seamlessly integrates indoor and outdoor spaces, creating a sense of freedom. Its expansive deck areas, finished with natural teak on the main deck and flybridge, as well as ESTHEC on the swim platform, are perfect for entertaining. Stainless-steel floating stairs with teak treads lead to the flybridge, where recessed lighting enhances the ambiance under the overhang.

The aft side combings transform into hydraulic side balconies, offering stunning ocean views and expanding the deck’s social space. At the bow, a sun lounge with sofas, a retractable table that converts into a sun pad, and drink holders provide the perfect spot for relaxation.

Meets Functionality

Inside, the yacht is equally impressive. The master stateroom features private access, a queen-size bed, and air conditioning with reverse-cycle heat. Accommodation includes four cabins, each with its own en-suite head, ensuring comfort and privacy for all guests. The galley boasts Ceramic Laminated Oxide countertops, a stainless-steel sink, and FRIGOMAR AC refrigerators, blending style and practicality.

The salon’s stainless-steel sliding and folding doors open to the aft deck, creating a seamless flow between spaces. An 8-seat retractable table and L-shaped lounge seating make it ideal for hosting. The flybridge is equipped with SIMRAD electronics, stainless steel safety handrails, and three adjustable Lebrock helm seats, ensuring every journey is as smooth as it is stylish.

Power and Performance

Powered by twin MAN V12 1550 hp engines with cardan shaft and TWIN-DISC MGX 5146 RV V-drives, the 80′ Okean delivers outstanding performance and reliability.
